dependents.na: Test fixture repository has no importers of the changed file.

duplicates.na: Test fixture repository has no copied markup or logic.

otherPaths.na: Test fixture repository has a single entry point.

sharedState.na: Test fixture repository stores no shared state.

included.behavior: Every fixture file follows the task criteria.

initialState.na: Fixture has no persisted state to start from.

redo.na: Fixture operations are not retried or redelivered.

timeBoundary.na: Fixture has no dates, TTLs or timezones.

identitySwitch.na: Fixture has no stores, roles or tenants.

concurrency.na: Fixture runs one writer at a time.
